canonical_name: BASIC Computer Games (David Ahl, 1978): HAMURABI and SUPER STAR TREK -- original BASIC listings run under Bywater BASIC
lineage: The hobbyist BASIC culture of the 1970s: HAMURABI (a resource-rationing simulation under scarcity and random plague/rat pressure, from DEC's 1968 'King'/'Sumer' via Ahl) and SUPER STAR TREK (Mayfield 1971; Leedom/Ahl 1974-78), the most-copied game program of its era. Preserved as the original line-numbered BASIC (from the coding-horror/basic-computer-games transcription of Ahl's book) and executed by Bywater BASIC 2.20, itself a 1990s interpreter of the classic dialect.

source_identity.book: Ahl (ed.), BASIC Computer Games, Microcomputer Edition, 1978

license.status: the repository is Unlicense for its ports; the 1978 listings are Ahl's book, widely republished; recorded, not asserted

entry_points: bwbasic hammurabi.bas (10 turns of grain/land/people decisions); bwbasic superstartrek.bas

example.output: the ten-year report (population, acres, starvation) -- deterministic given bwBASIC's RND seeding

human_capability_summary.built_to: let a player govern a city for ten years by rationing grain between food, seed and land purchases under random harvests, rats and plague (HAMURABI); command a starship against Klingons with finite energy and torpedoes (STAR TREK)
human_capability_summary.pressure: scarcity (grain, energy), randomness, deadlines (ten years; stardates)
human_capability_summary.success_means: the program runs the simulation to its end state and reports it; the classic dialect executes under a later interpreter

human_environmental_pressure: scarcity, random shocks, hard time limit
human_failure_condition: starve the people -> impeachment; run out of energy -> destruction
behavioral_entry_point: script different rationing policies into hammurabi.bas's INPUTs and compare the ten-year outcomes

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run basic-computer-games-1978
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: let a player govern a city for ten years by rationing grain between food, seed and land purchases under random harvests, rats and plague (HAMURABI); command a starship against Klingons with finite energy and torpedoes (STAR TREK)
